value.text: Got the Preschool Sports and Games page for Maya. It runs Wednesdays at 10:30 AM, ages 3 to 5, $280.60 ($290.60 non-resident), course code 00028147. Residents open Sep 8, and the public date is Tuesday, September 15 at 10:30 a.m. I had Monday, September 14 at 10:30 a.m. before, but the page says the 15th, so I'm going by the page. This course has a registration form to fill out before you can sign up, so leave some time for that.
